title: Source every threshold a check enforces
statement: Trace every threshold a check enforces to its source before failing content on it, because a gate without a sourced reason is a preference.
example: Against the sourced floor, 79 of 81 item banks passed; an unsourced one had failed all of them.
detail: An audit of a Grade 5 course failed all 81 of its item banks on a size floor of 15. Traced to its source, the 15 appeared as a rule only in the audit script and in a spec line quoting that script, while the course's generator set a floor of 8 with a stated reason; the 15 was the top of an 8–15 target band, hard-coded as the floor. Against the floor of 8, 79 of 81 banks passed and 2 fell short (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-merged-course/audit-heuristic-finding.md`). The reading project's draft certification standard asks every new gate to name its provenance, the comment or measurement behind it, since a gate without provenance is a preference (`grade3-reading/artifacts/team-direction-2026-09-09/GATE-STANDARD-DRAFT.md`).

Every threshold carries the BrainLift tag it inherits (`[LE]` learning evidence, `[AR]` accessibility requirement, `[PC]` platform constraint, `[OH]` operating heuristic).
**An `[OH]` is a heuristic, never a proven learning threshold — findings cite it as "outside the doctrine band", never "harms learning".**
`[OH]` = operating heuristic; enforce as the current default but never claim it is proven.
